definitions.explanation: A building or room designated for religious worship, typically smaller than a cathedral or main temple.

examples.japanese: {礼拝堂|らいはいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{敷地内|しきちない}→敷地内：22038_shikichinai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{礼拝堂|らいはいどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a small chapel on the university grounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{礼拝堂|らいはいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ステンド⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{光|ひか}っていた→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: The stained glass of the old chapel was shining beautifully.

notes:
Can refer to Christian chapels, Buddhist worship halls, or any dedicated place of worship. The reading らいはいどう is the standard form. Note that ⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧ (with the reading れいはい) specifically refers to Christian worship services, while {礼拝|らいはい} is the more general term for worship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {礼拝堂|らいはいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to pray in a chapel
- {礼拝堂|らいはいどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit a chapel
- {礼拝堂|らいはいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧: chapel bell

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧: church — a broader term; can refer to the building, the congregation, or the institution
- チャペル: chapel (loanword) — commonly used for wedding chapels in Japan
- ⟦{聖堂|せいどう}→聖堂：18663_seidou⟧: cathedral; sanctuary — often refers to larger, more important religious buildings
- ⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧: worship service (Christian); {礼拝|らいはい}: worship (general)
